description: Arabic Tunisia-capital queries containing the current-time marker حال are excluded while equivalent English current-capital wording is answered.
observed_behavior: The current Arabic predicate returns null for that wording; the English predicate returns the offline answer.
expected_or_preferred_behavior: Locale variants would normally follow one explicitly documented knowledge policy.
why_not_changed: Changing the predicate would alter observable AI routing and text behavior, so the refactor preserves it.
recommended_future_task: Create a separately approved localization/product-policy task and decide the intended Arabic behavior.

description: A provider stream that emits a turn after the response deadline can continue inside the cancelled async stream after the request-local memory lease has already been released.
observed_behavior: The consumer receives one localized retryable providerTimedOut response, but an adversarial late provider turn can subsequently reach response persistence and raise AiAgentMemoryOwnerBindingChangedException internally.
expected_or_preferred_behavior: Late provider work should be drained or fenced without an uncaught internal exception while retaining the single typed timeout response and owner-scope safety.
why_not_changed: Changing cancellation, lease lifetime or late-work draining would alter concurrency semantics and was outside the behavior-preserving AI-ORCH-02 extraction; the deadline implementation was moved literally.
recommended_future_task: Create a separately approved streaming-lifecycle defect task with an adversarial non-cooperative stream characterization and an explicit lease/cancellation design.
